## How do you calculate the ROI of using Razorpay for your business?


A payment gateway’s ROI depends on what your business keeps after payment costs, not just the percentage quoted on a pricing page. Measure completed orders, contribution margin, transaction fees, optional services and the time your team spends managing payments.


Razorpay gives you a clear starting point for that calculation:[published standard pricing with no setup fee or AMC](https://razorpay.com/pricing/) , plus payment and reporting tools for running collections. Evaluate it using your own payment mix and completed-order results. When those tools reduce work or improve the economics of your actual checkout, the benefit belongs in your ROI calculation.


### Calculate the contribution you keep


For each payment method, calculate:


**Gateway fee = successfully processed value × your contracted fee rate.**


Then calculate:


**Payment-related contribution = contribution from completed orders − gateway fees − non-recoverable taxes − fixed charges − optional-service charges − payment-operation costs − attributable refund, dispute and fraud costs.**


Use contribution before payment costs, rather than treating all collected revenue as profit. Track recoverable tax separately from cash outflow. Where a fee is based on a different charging event, use the applicable contract rule. Avoid counting retries as additional completed orders.


**Illustration, not a performance claim:** at ₹10 lakh of successful domestic payment value, a 2% platform fee is ₹20,000 before GST. A 1.95% quote would be ₹19,500 before GST, a ₹500 difference. With everything else equal, the lower quote costs less. Razorpay creates better value only if the features and operational benefits you actually use justify the difference.


For a fair comparison, use the same payment mix, period, order definition and cost categories. Run a separate sensitivity case for any proposed conversion improvement; do not put an unmeasured uplift into your base case.


## What Is a Payment Gateway ROI Calculator and Why Does India Need a Different One?


A payment gateway ROI calculator compares payment-related business contribution with the cost of accepting and managing payments. It should distinguish attempted transactions from completed orders and collected revenue from contribution after costs. Use the contribution method above with your actual payment mix.


## The 5 Inputs Every Indian Payment Gateway ROI Calculator Must Have


Record five groups of inputs: completed-order value and contribution margin; your payment-method mix and contracted rates; fixed and optional charges; settlement funding costs; and attributable refunds, fraud, disputes and operating effort. Use observed checkout outcomes for the base case and clearly label any unmeasured improvement as a sensitivity scenario.


Standard bank-to-bank UPI has zero bank MDR, while Razorpay charges a separate standard platform fee of 2% plus applicable GST unless your approved offer or contract specifies otherwise. Use the[current pricing page](https://razorpay.com/pricing/) and your contracted rates when budgeting.


## How Razorpay Delivers ROI That Shows Up in Your Calculator

If you request[Instant Settlements](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/settlements/) , include the applicable charges and measure any funding benefit rather than assuming all working-capital costs disappear.


## Compare completion improvements and fee savings fairly


Measure completed orders and payment costs over the same period. Retry attempts can later succeed, so an unsuccessful attempt does not necessarily represent a lost sale. Value a measured increase in completed orders using contribution margin and incremental fees. Whether completion rate or fee savings matters more depends on your business.


## Hidden Costs That Indian Payment Gateway ROI Calculators Usually Miss


Include taxes on service fees, fixed charges in your actual contract, refund fee treatment, dispute charges and optional services. Separate cash outflow from recoverable tax and confirm eligibility for any tax credit with your tax adviser. Avoid counting the same returned order or loss in more than one cost line.


## How to Calculate the ROI of Switching Payment Gateways in India


Estimate one-time migration costs separately from recurring operating costs. Compare measured monthly contribution after payment costs on a consistent basis. If that monthly improvement is positive, estimated payback months equal one-time migration cost divided by the improvement. If it is zero or negative, the model does not demonstrate payback. Include engineering, testing and operational transition costs using your own estimates.


## Payment Gateway ROI by Business Type – SaaS vs D2C vs Marketplace


ROI differs by business type because the dominant variable shifts. For SaaS, it is recurring billing success. For D2C, it is cart abandonment and RTO. For marketplaces, it is split settlement delay.


### SaaS and Subscription Businesses


The primary variable is recurring payment success rate.[UPI Autopay](https://razorpay.com/blog/what-is-upi-autopay-recurring-payments-razorpay-subscriptions) mandates up to ₹15,000 are the default for lower-ticket SaaS, and failed renewals drive churn. Add: (monthly mandate failure rate x subscription value) x (1 – recovery rate from retry logic). GST invoicing automation saves finance-team labor.


### D2C E-Commerce Merchants


The primary variable is checkout conversion rate x AOV. Add an RTO cost line, because rejected COD orders create logistics plus lost-sale costs that address pre-fill reduces. India’s active online shopper base reached 290-300 million in 2025, with Tier 2 cities contributing roughly 50% of incremental orders. D2C brands can find a detailed cost breakdown in our guide to the[cheapest payment gateway for D2C brands in India](https://razorpay.com/blog/cheapest-payment-gateway-for-a-d2c-brand-in-india/) .


### Marketplaces and Platforms


The primary variable is split payment settlement delay and vendor payout cost. Add a vendor payout fee per transaction and the working capital cost of holding float. Razorpay Route automates split payments and eliminates manual reconciliation labor, so include reconciliation hours saved.

## Sensitivity Analysis – Which Variable Moves Your ROI the Most?


Keep a base case with observed performance, then vary one assumption at a time: contracted fee, completed-order conversion, settlement funding cost, operating effort or dispute loss. Show contribution impact rather than labelling every change as additional revenue. Record assumptions and compare both upside and downside cases.

## Frequently Asked Questions


### How do I calculate payment gateway ROI in India?


Use contribution from completed orders before payment costs, then deduct gateway fees, non-recoverable taxes, fixed and optional charges, operating costs and attributable losses. Compare that result consistently across providers. The contribution method and illustrative fee calculation are set out at the top of this article.


### What is the total cost of ownership for a payment gateway in India?


It includes MDR, 18% GST on that MDR, AMC (zero to ₹10,000/year), amortized setup, working capital cost of settlement delay, unrecovered MDR on refunds, and fraud costs. Most merchants track only MDR, understating their true cost.


### Does payment success rate or MDR matter more for ROI?


Compare the complete cost for the same payment mix and successful sales volume. Include gateway fees, applicable tax, fixed charges and optional services. A lower rate is cheaper when other costs and outcomes are equal; use measured business benefits rather than an assumed success-rate advantage to evaluate additional value.


### How does GST affect my payment gateway cost in India?


18% GST is levied on the MDR amount, not the transaction value. Whatever your MDR rate, multiply by 1.18 to get the true effective fee percentage. GST-registered businesses can claim Input Tax Credit. Non-registered businesses absorb it as a permanent cost.


### Is UPI MDR really zero for Indian merchants?


### How do I calculate the working capital ROI of Instant Settlement?


Measure the average funds you can access earlier, the time saved and your actual financing cost. Deduct the cost of the faster-settlement service. Faster access does not automatically eliminate funding costs or create a universal saving.


### What is a good payment success rate benchmark for Indian merchants?


Use a benchmark matched to payment method, issuer mix, transaction definition and period. No universal success-rate percentage in this article establishes Razorpay’s performance for your account. Compare your measured results and clearly separate technical success from completed-order conversion.


### How is payment gateway ROI different for SaaS versus e-commerce businesses?


For SaaS, the dominant variable is recurring mandate success rate. For e-commerce, it is checkout conversion and RTO cost on COD. Both use the same five-input framework, but the weights differ by business type.


### Can I claim input tax credit on payment gateway GST charges?


GST-registered businesses can generally claim ITC on gateway service fees, since these are B2B services. Confirm with a CA. Non-registered merchants cannot claim ITC and must include the full 18% GST as a permanent cost.
